context: Two teens chat about club activities
purpose: Teach: 柔道/忍者/空手/ご馳走/吹奏楽/剣道/スケッチ/リフレッシュ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 柔道部、また昇段試験あるんだって。
lines.en: Judo club has another promotion test coming up.
lines.style: Bright and conversational opening. Quick, natural pacing. Leans in slightly — sharing club news like it matters to someone she respects. No performance, just genuine.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 忍者みたいに、素早く動く練習、面白いよな。
lines.en: Those ninja-like agility drills are actually fun, you know?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing. A beat before 'actually' — like he's surprised by his own admission. Soft, genuine tone. Not trying to impress, just honestly noticing something.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 空手部の友達も、見学に来てくれる。
lines.en: Friends from karate club are coming to watch.
lines.style: Bright and matter-of-fact. Quick tempo. A small lift in her voice on 'coming' — pleased about having people there without being effusive about it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試合後、ご馳走になることもあるよ。
lines.en: We get treated to food afterwards sometimes.
lines.style: Warm, lazy smile in his voice. Slower tempo on this one — savoring the idea. Not trying hard, just genuinely content. Slight trailing-off like he's already thinking about the meal.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 吹奏楽部、終演後の打ち上げ、賑やかだって。
lines.en: The band club throws pretty wild after-show parties, apparently.
lines.style: Light, slightly envious tone — the way a friend talks about another group's fun without jealousy. Quick delivery. Genuine curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 剣道部、礼儀正しいよな。
lines.en: Kendo club really does have that politeness thing down.
lines.style: Genuinely impressed, quiet respect in his voice. Measured pacing. A slight nod-quality to it — acknowledging something he values. Not patronizing, just sincere.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭で、皆でスケッチ展示しよう。
lines.en: We should all put our sketches up together at the culture fest.
lines.style: Animated and inclusive. Forward momentum in her voice. 'Together' lands with warmth — she's inviting him into something. No doubt, just bright suggestion.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 長期休暇に、温泉でリフレッシュしたい。
lines.en: I want to hit up a hot spring over the long break, just to reset.
lines.style: Quieter than before. A little vulnerable — admitting something he wants. Soft landing on 'reset,' like a small exhale. Wistful but grounded, not dramatic.
